acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC1: Added a dedicated vertical separator handle between electrical and mechanical tree panels in Combined view with keyboard (ArrowUp/ArrowDown) and drag support via shared resize logic. Implemented in src/app/features/facility/components/containers/combined-structure/combined-structure.component.html and .ts, with styling in combined-structure.component.scss. Proven by playwright/tests/facility-pages/combined-structure-tree-height-resize.e2e.spec.ts tests 'resizes tree panel height via keyboard arrow keys on the separator' and 'resizes tree panel height via vertical drag handle'.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC2: Tree viewport height resizing uses the same drag-to-resize interaction pattern as horizontal panel resizing by reusing onResizerMouseDown/startDrag/resizePanelsByOffset with axis switching (data-resize-axis='y'). Implemented in src/app/features/facility/components/containers/combined-structure/combined-structure.component.ts and .html, and exercised by 'drag handle updates electrical and mechanical tree heights independently' in playwright/tests/facility-pages/combined-structure-tree-height-resize.e2e.spec.ts.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.AC3: Vertical resizing clamps both tree panels to configured minimum height using getMinSize and clamped offset calculations, with min height configured in SCSS (--combined-tree-panel-min-height and min-height on tree panels). Implemented in combined-structure.component.ts and combined-structure.component.scss. Proven by 'clamps tree panel height at configured minimum during drag' in playwright/tests/facility-pages/combined-structure-tree-height-resize.e2e.spec.ts and unit assertion in combined-structure.component.spec.ts.
